💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Living Wire: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — mosquito: Hit it after it drinks. It only drinks adjacent — keep your distance during the dive. After it drinks it's HEAVY and SLOW: that's when you hit it. Smoke and fire ruin its whole plan. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Nevermore: Step OFF the strafing lane. The shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides — a straight black lane. Step OFF it, not along it: it can't turn mid-run. It always lands after a run, hit or miss. Punish the landing. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Understudy: Hit it with something it's never seen. It copies what it sees — strike with a weapon it has NEVER seen and the copy falls apart. The familiar is what kills you. Switch weapons mid-fight and it's back to guessing. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Rut King: Give it a tree. His antler rack catches on trunks — keep a tree between you and let the charge tangle. Step aside at the last breath and strike while he is pulling free. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — tick: Keep two squares away. Keep 2+ squares away and it's harmless — it can't chase. Don't walk up to it. Latched: burn it off with fire, or let it feed full and drop on its own. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Grief Counselor: Sidestep the charge. Break line of sight during the mirror beat and the charge dies unspent — or sidestep: it can't turn mid-charge. Don't look at the reflection. Look at its feet — they tell you where it's going. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — White Noise: Step off the line. When it unfolds, SIDESTEP — it commits to the line and can't correct. Watch the water, not the bird: it strikes where you were standing, never where you are. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
